items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I worked at the Balloon with a fellow by the name of Munson Hickman... And we worked at the Bungalow for a while.

ctx.x: Well, West End, I worked at West End a good while. I worked at the Balloon with a fellow by the name of Munson Hickman, a saxophone player. And we worked at the Bungalow for a while. We left there and went to the C-Plan, and from the C-Plan we went to, well, another fellow used to be a racer around the island, called him Bill Wade. He had a nightclub out there. Well, I worked out there until they completely demolished all the camps. We were one of the last bands out there.
And who were you with out there?
